description: An LED display made of seven segments plus a decimal point, in 1/2/3/4-digit variants (the `digits` attribute).
how_to_use: 1-digit variant: COM.1/COM.2 are two physical legs (top and bottom) always tied together internally — either one works identically. Multi-digit variants (verified via docs.wokwi.com/parts/wokwi-7segment) drop COM entirely in favor of one DIG1..DIGN pin per digit (the segment lines A-G/DP are a single shared bus across all digits, driven one digit at a time by multiplexing); a 4-digit clock-style display can also expose a CLN (colon) pin when its `colon` attribute is set.

plain.what: A display that shows one number (0–9) using seven little light bars.
plain.how: Each bar is its own LED: light the right bars to draw a number. Each needs a resistor.
